Sarasota-Area Museums — January 2027

Updated Wednesday, November 25, 2026, 4:12 AM ET

Summary

Summary

January is peak season. It brings a wave of new exhibitions and the busiest lecture calendar of the year, along with festivals and evening events. Here are the standouts:

  • New exhibitions: Ringling College Galleries opens Keith Haring: Lines in Motion, a student-curated show of more than 100 works (Jan 19). It also opens Matt Myers: Blood & Bone & Gilt and the Basch Glass Exhibition (Jan 11). Art Center Sarasota opens four shows on Jan 21, including the juried Monochrome, with an opening night reception from 5 to 7 PM. The Venice Art Center opens All Around Town on Jan 15.
  • Talks and lectures: Mote SEA’s Mote-ivational lectures run Mondays, Jan 4–25 ($15); Jan 18 is a red tide panel. The Ringling has a Viewpoint Lecture with glass artist Joanna Manousis (Jan 22) and a gallery talk (Jan 19). SAM has the Quotable Talk with Kory Stamper (Jan 16) and Art at Noon (Jan 19). The Historical Society’s Conversations at The Crocker cover Pinecraft (Jan 17) and Bertha Palmer (Jan 31). The Venice Art Center has two Baila Miller lectures (Jan 12 and 26).
  • Festivals and big nights: Crowley’s Myakka River Rendezvous (Jan 30–31). Mote’s Black and White Party (Jan 23). Art Center Sarasota’s Retro Remix (Jan 9) and its sculpture garden ribbon cutting (Jan 16). The Bishop’s free Sidewalk Astronomy night (Jan 15).
  • Music, film and theater: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World at the Historic Asolo Theater (Jan 14–15). Ringling by the Bay (Jan 18) and Jazz Sunsets (Jan 26). The Windjammers Circus Music Concert is free for families with children (Jan 15). SAM has After Hours and Art on Film, both on Jan 26.
  • Last chances: Selby’s Lights in Bloom® has its final nights Jan 1–2. The last sunset Skyspace is Jan 6. The Ringling’s The Art of Care and Canvas City close Jan 3. The Venice Art Center’s Sweet Dreams ends Jan 7, and Art Center Sarasota’s Juried Members Show ends Jan 9.
  • For kids: Selby has Sensory Saturdays (Jan 16), Tranquil Tuesdays (Jan 12), the Little Sprouts Club (Jan 7 and 22) and Family Saturday (Jan 30). The Bishop has Backyard Science every Saturday and KidSpace on Jan 2. Mote has Shark Pups & Grown Ups (Jan 16 and 30), and SAM’s Free Second Sunday is Jan 10.

On New Year’s Day, The Ringling, SAM, The Bishop, De Soto, the Gamble Plantation visitor center and the Venice Art Center are closed. Both Selby campuses and Jungle Gardens stay open. No museum posts changed hours for MLK Day (Jan 18), and The Ringling is open that day. See holiday closures for details. The Florida Maritime Museum stays closed all month.
